resources.string: Describe a sticker and this phone, or an image service you pick, draws it
Draws on this phone. Nothing you type leaves it.
Sends your prompt, in English, to %1$s.
Sends your prompt, in English, to %1$s, which draws on a transparent background.
Tries %1$s, in that order, until one draws.
Every engine is off or not set up. Switch one on under Engines below.

Who draws the stickers. On this phone, nothing leaves it. An online service gets the prompt in English and sends the pictures back; Pollinations and AI Horde need no key, the others use your own. Pick one above the prompt, or set the list to fall back from one to the next.
Data saver is on for this connection. Tap Generate again to send the prompt anyway.
Data saver keeps online AI off this connection, so only the phone\'s model can draw. Its Cloud AI row decides this.

The model runs on this phone, in a process of its own, and nothing you type leaves it unless the prompt needs an online translator. SDXS draws in one step on any phone. Stable Diffusion 1.5 (NPU) runs on the Snapdragon 8 Gen 3, 8 Elite and 8 Elite Gen 5 neural processors and takes a negative prompt and guidance.
20 steps on the NPU, negative prompts
This model\'s files could not be read. Delete it and import or download it again.
A converted model: a zip, or its five files picked together

The phone downloads this model (%1$s with the picture filter) from the project\'s data repository. Its weights are under the CreativeML OpenRAIL++-M licence, which you accept to use them: it forbids using the model for illegal, harmful or deceptive content, and those restrictions pass to anything you make with it.

The phone downloads Qualcomm AI Hub\'s build of Stable Diffusion 1.5 for this chip (%1$s with the picture filter) from Qualcomm, and Qualcomm\'s NPU runtime. The weights are under the CreativeML OpenRAIL-M licence, which forbids using the model for illegal, harmful or deceptive content, and the runtime under Qualcomm\'s licence. You accept both to use them.

This model draws in one step without guidance, so it has no negative prompt or step count to set.
Lift the subject off the background before the editor opens
This build has no background remover; the editor\'s eraser still works

Run the model on the phone\'s graphics chip instead of its processor. Often faster, but the first picture waits while the GPU compiles its code, and on some phones the processor is quicker. Where the GPU cannot run it, the processor draws instead.
Check every picture with an on-device classifier and hold back unsafe ones. Prompts are always checked.
Ask the service to hold back unsafe pictures, where it has a switch for that. Prompts are always checked first.
Not every service reads one: Gemini, GPT Image and Grok Imagine leave it out.
